wedo_instance.title: WeDo Template: Standard Forensic Report Schema
wedo_instance.description: Schema for structured reporting of session results, collaborative dynamics, and technical strikes.

rules.direct_aesthetic: Reports must be presented to the User 'straightup'—no triple-backtick Markdown wrappers. Use plain text with clear headers and bolding.
rules.iteration_mandate: Every report MUST start at a minimum of 1000 words. Each subsequent draft MUST increase the word count, ensuring maximum forensic density and the preservation of hard-won wisdom.
rules.dual_referencing: Every location MUST reference both localhost paths and remotehost URLs.
rules.audit_scrutiny: List ALL changes and requests directly from the source. Document resolutions in granular detail.
rules.active_investigation: Verify artifact existence on localhost before inclusion.
rules.storage_protocol: Store process artifacts in '.hidden/' subdirectories; promote to parent folders only upon 'straightup' request.

structure.description: Title, Date, Agent Identity, User Identity, and Project/Branch context.
High-level overview of the session or task.
Structured data: Time, Velocity, Capacities, or Repository changes.
Narrative on collaboration (HITL), corrections, and 'Hard-Won Knowledge' (Boomerang/Synaptic principles).
Integration of PNG Journal artifacts or code snippets.
Links to internal Git artifacts and external references (Local/Remote).
Actionable task list for the singular thread.
